entries.review_note: Sakura volunteers for branch collection although fatigued; this is bounded social participation.
Kiyotaka notices an injured newcomer while Yamauchi wants to proceed; no one yet knows her plan.
Ibuki asserts she is Class C and resists help; her cover story must remain attributed.
Yamauchi's attempted fire-starting fails after lighting matches against unsuitable damp, thick fuel.
Ike identifies tinder size and moisture problems and produces a flame; specific outdoor competence.
Ike directly apologizes to Shinohara, who reciprocates; change beyond the episode is unknown.
Hirata advocates a budget with target 120 points left; forecast not actual end score.
Hirata seeks camp hospitality for injured Ibuki without conclusive verification of her account.
Kushida and friends share rations on page 96, not proof the newcomer is honest.
Teacher reports Kōenji medically retired and a 30-point cost; deliberate faking is not proven.
Kiyotaka secretly inspects Ibuki's rental camera, then hears Hirata's early budget anxiety and class ambitions.
Kanzaki visits Class D and reveals Class B camp location; his alleged ulterior motives are Kiyotaka's hypothesis.
Komiya and Kondou, not Ishizaki, bring Ryūen's beach message to mock Ike.
Expensive Class C beach amenities are observed; inferred total expenditure is only an estimate.
Ryūen rebukes Ishizaki over drink temperature; the effect on durable loyalty is unestablished.
Ryūen discusses punishing Ibuki; later Ibuki privately says the slap was staged for infiltration.
Conjectures about why Ryūen spent points are Kiyotaka's, not a demonstrated strategy model.
Class B facilities and Ichinose's cordial reception are observed, without revealing all its plans.
Ichinose reports cautious well testing before shared use; she is not proved the individual technician.
Ichinose explains reuse of sanitation materials and water cooling; measurements are not supplied.
Horikita proposes limited Class B–D cooperation and Ichinose engages, but no perpetual alliance is concluded.
Kiyotaka and Horikita approach an occupied Class A cave to gather information, not to own it.
Yahiko objects and Katsuragi counters with a reciprocity argument on pages 128–129.
Sakura catches up with Kiyotaka in the forest; mutual comfort is not identical to established romance.
Sakura reports the former clerk resigned; no administrative employment record verifies it.
Sakura identifies cultivated corn hidden in brush; food utility is assessed locally.
Kiyotaka improvises carrying harvested corn with his clothing, without establishing survival expertise broadly.
Katsuragi tempers Yahiko and warns about hazards of moving alone; no complete Class D strategy is learned.
On day four fish, corn and fruit ease shortages; interim point estimate is narration.
Kiyotaka maps a watchtower and nearby possibilities, not a complete validated island map.
Class A boys frisk Kiyotaka and seize a hand-drawn map; no consensual information exchange occurs.
Class A pupils propose future points for information; bargain remains uncompleted.
Class C's earlier costly shore setup is largely deserted; reason for departures is not directly witnessed.
Ichinose and Kanzaki discuss competing Class A factions and absent Sakayanagi, partly from reports.
Pre-island flashback dates Chabashira's private summons before the exam, not on island day four.
Chabashira says an outsider sought expulsion of Kiyotaka; institutional authority of that outsider is unverified.
Teacher pressures him with disciplinary discretion; this is her threat, not proof of lawful arbitrary expulsion.
Girlfriend reports missing underwear and collective suspicion begins; culprit not yet known.
Clothing hidden in Ike's luggage is not evidence Ike placed or stole it.
Kiyotaka conceals underwear transferred to him to prevent public accusation; theft remains unresolved.
